title: Smoothness of the explicit separable-preparation quotient
statement: Let k be a field and A a finitely presented k-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Let d,n,m be natural numbers with n≥1 and a:Fin m→A generate H_{A/k} [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal]. Set R=k[X_i | i∈Fin d] [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] and B=A[X_i,Z_ij]/(X_i^n−Σ_j Z_ij a_j), with its R-algebra structure sending X_i to its class. Then B is finitely presented over R; every B_(a_j) and every B_(X_i) is smooth over R [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map].

proof.text: Form the explicitly defined polynomial quotient B=A[X_i,Z_ij]/(X_i^n−Σ_j Z_ij a_j). Combine a finite presentation of A over k with the finitely many auxiliary variables and equations to obtain finite presentation over R=k[X_i].

Each a_j belongs to H_{A/k}, so A_(a_j) is smooth over k. After inverting a_j, solve all equations for Z_ij; B_(a_j) is a polynomial algebra in the remaining Z variables over A_(a_j)[X_i]. Smoothness follows by base change and composition.

The relation for X_i implies that the a_j generate the unit ideal in B_(X_i). Apply smoothness locality on this cover, using smoothness of the doubly localized a_j opens. If m=0 the localization is zero. If d=0 there are no X opens or relations.
